subject: Re: Kickoff: fairness evaluation module - decision: option (a), selection coverage to Q3
body:
Decision: option (a). V1 ships with the guardrails scoped to what they demonstrably catch (84% at 7% false-flag on the covered DGP families) and an explicit, prominent "selection effects not covered" disclaimer, with Umar drafting the disclaimer language so it's technically precise rather than legal boilerplate. The questionnaire approach (b) becomes a Q3 OKR - I'm writing it in before the Jun 26 lock, sized with Carmen at 50%.

Rationale for the record: a fairness tool that overclaims its own coverage would be exactly the failure mode this project exists to prevent. Nadia agreed at the M2 review and will socialize the disclaimer framing with the launch-review board before our July integration proposal lands.

July power study proceeds as planned on our reserved week; M3 review set for Jul 16. Nice work getting the hard conversation done early.

Dmitri
